text:
rachael: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few timeline clarifications we promised during the Q&A about Console, Optimize, and API batching. Can product/eng confirm specifics so we can tell partners?

sam: Yep — main asks were: exact canary window for the Console instrumentation dashboard, whether Optimize suggestions appear in UI during canary, and which routing modes are included in canary.

maria: Product: Canary = next Wednesday (2024-05-08) through Friday internally, then extended to 3 partner accounts from Mon 2024-05-13 for two weeks. GA target: late June.

kevin: Engineering: Canary will include generation + embeddings routes only. Routing fallback/dedicated capacity will be in the second canary (week after partner canary). Optimize quick-suggestions API will be read-only during partner canary.

rachael: Are there pass/fail criteria we can publish to partners?

maria: Yes: (1) P95 latency <= baseline * 1.2, (2) 5xx < 0.2%, (3) partner UX sign-off, (4) Optimize suggestions validated on >=2 internal workloads.

olivia: Sales asked for a short blurb for partner outreach — can we say Optimize UI suggestions are "read-only during canary, full recommendation panel in GA (June)"?

maria: That phrasing works. I'll draft and post to #marketing.

sam: Ops: partner canary traffic will route to Hosted only. Dedicated tests planned in follow-up canary — we'll need to pre-warm two dedicated GPU pools for that.

kevin: Note on DB work: Optimize has a small, backwards-compatible migration for recommendation history. No blocking migrations. Feature flags present for quick rollback.

rachael: Owners: Maria -> partner comms and marketing blurb; Sam -> runbook + dashboard link by EOD Friday; Kevin -> pre-warm plan & migration notes. Add anything else here.

eng-ops-bot: scheduled: canary-dashboard:v1 -> staging 2024-05-02T18:00Z. Auto-notify partners when staging validated.

maria: I'll add the partner acceptance checklist to the runbook and tag owners.

sam: Will post runbook link here when ready.

rachael: Thanks all. If anyone has blocking concerns, flag here. :thumbsup:
